facebook.content:
Family

As we focus on rebuilding our homes and strengthening our family bonds, let us pray for a revival of love and unity within our families. 

Lord, I declare that every family connected to Increasing Faith Ministries will be filled with Your presence and Your love. Let Your Spirit bring correction and restoration to any broken relationships, and fill our homes with laughter, joy, and peace. I decree that every child will be raised with a strong sense of identity and purpose in Christ.

instagram.content:
Prayer Focus: Family

My family will be the salt and light that shines in our communities. We will be a force for change, bringing healing and hope to those around us.

Father, we declare that our families are a sacred institution in the kingdom. We call forth the revelation of your love and purposes in our homes. Let your glory be revealed in the way we love and serve one another.
